text: I feel a sense of curiosity in this space, surrounded by glass and vibrant colors. The environment feels modern, almost futuristic, dedicated to innovation and research. The large R + D on the wall draws me into the theme of creativity and exploration. There is a sense of anticipation—as if knowledge is just behind every door or display, inviting me to reflect on progress and discovery. I feel a little out of alignment, as if the physical tilt mirrors a disorientation one feels when entering new realms of thought.
